about: The secreta of the formulary “Purification of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O Lord, heed our prayer, and give us the help of Your loving kindness so that the gifts we offer before the eyes of Your majesty may be worthy of You. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
